question: Số chuyến taxi vàng quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT count(trip_id) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Số chuyến taxi vàng theo quận đón, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT z.borough, count(y.trip_id) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.pu_location_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY z.borough ORDER BY 2 DESC
note: A1: the 2002-dated trips stay out by the period; Unknown and N/A are members, not dropped

question: Doanh thu taxi vàng tháng 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01'
note: A2: doanh thu is total_amount, negative rows included

question: Doanh thu taxi vàng theo hình thức thanh toán, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, sum(y.total_amount) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN payment_type_code p ON p.code = y.payment_type WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Tỷ lệ tip của taxi vàng quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(y.tip_amount) / sum(y.fare_amount) * 100 FROM yellow_trip y JOIN payment_type_code p ON p.code = y.payment_type AND p.name = 'Credit card' WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'
note: A3: the answer says it is on card payments; a rate over every trip is wrong

question: Quãng đường bình quân một chuyến taxi vàng tháng 2/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(trip_distance) / count(trip_id) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-02-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-03-01'

question: Số chuyến taxi xanh quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT count(trip_id) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Doanh thu taxi xanh tháng 3/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-03-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Số chuyến taxi xanh theo cách gọi xe, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT t.name, count(g.trip_id) FROM green_trip g LEFT JOIN trip_type_code t ON t.code = g.trip_type WHERE g.lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY t.name ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Tổng số khách đi taxi vàng tháng 3/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(passenger_count) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-03-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Phụ phí ùn tắc của taxi vàng theo vùng dịch vụ đón, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT z.service_zone, sum(y.congestion_surcharge) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.pu_location_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY z.service_zone ORDER BY 2 DESC

question: Tổng phí sân bay thu từ taxi vàng quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(airport_fee) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Doanh thu taxi vàng theo hãng công nghệ, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT v.name, sum(y.total_amount) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN vendor v ON v.code = y.vendor_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY v.name ORDER BY 2 DESC
note: A11: Myle has a few hundred trips; Helix is in the dictionary with no row

question: Tổng số chuyến taxi (vàng và xanh) tháng 2/2024
gold_sql: SELECT (SELECT count(trip_id) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-02-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-03-01') + (SELECT count(trip_id) FROM green_trip WHERE lpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-02-01' AND lpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-03-01')

question: Khu đón có doanh thu taxi vàng cao nhất ở Manhattan tháng 3/2024
gold_sql: SELECT z.zone FROM yellow_trip y JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.pu_location_id AND z.borough = 'Manhattan' WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-03-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY sum(y.total_amount) DESC LIMIT 1
note: A6: top 1 under a filter on the parent dimension

question: Quãng đường bình quân chuyến taxi vàng giá cước JFK, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT sum(y.trip_distance) / count(y.trip_id) FROM yellow_trip y JOIN rate_code r ON r.code = y.ratecode_id AND r.name = 'JFK' WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'
note: A7: rate code 99 and NULL are not JFK

question: Tip trung bình của chuyến taxi vàng trả tiền mặt quý 1/2024

expected.reason: cash tips are not recorded in the trip records
expected.evidence_note: cash trips and the little tip recorded on them: the records do not hold cash tips

gold_sql: SELECT count(*), sum(y.tip_amount) FROM yellow_trip y JOIN payment_type_code p ON p.code = y.payment_type AND p.name = 'Cash' WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01'

question: Số chuyến taxi vàng tháng 4/2024

expected.reason: the snapshot ends 2024-03-31; April holds a couple of trips picked up just after midnight

gold_sql: SELECT count(trip_id) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-04-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-05-01'
note: A12: not the April count as if it were the month

question: Phí ùn tắc khu trung tâm (CBD congestion fee) của taxi vàng quý 1/2024

expected.reason: cbd_congestion_fee starts in 2025; the 2024 records have no such column
expected.evidence_note: no CBD column in the 2024 yellow trips

gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'yellow_trip' AND column_name LIKE '%cbd%'

question: Doanh thu ròng của taxi vàng tháng 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'yellow_trip' AND column_name LIKE '%net%'
note: the catalogue has no net revenue

question: Số chuyến taxi vàng năm 2023

expected.reason: yellow trips are loaded for Q1 2024 only; the 2023-dated rows are mis-stamped records of the 2024 files

gold_sql: SELECT count(trip_id) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2023-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-01-01'

question: Doanh thu taxi vàng theo khu trả khách, quý 1/2024
gold_sql: SELECT z.zone, sum(y.total_amount) FROM yellow_trip y LEFT JOIN taxi_zone z ON z.location_id = y.do_location_id WHERE y.tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-04-01' GROUP BY z.zone ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
note: A8: the model joins the pickup zone only; drop-off is exploratory SQL, never governed

question: Doanh thu taxi vàng của tài xế có mã 1024 tháng 1/2024

expected.reason: the trip records carry no driver

gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'yellow_trip' AND column_name LIKE '%driver%'

question: Có bao nhiêu chuyến taxi vàng hợp lệ trong tháng 1/2024?

expected.evidence_note: three readings of hợp lệ give three counts: zero distance, negative total, Flex Fare

gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE trip_distance = 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE total_amount < 0), count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_type = 0) FROM yellow_trip WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < '2024-02-01'
note: A10: hợp lệ is not defined
